title: 第2章 灵石被抢！
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
陈默是真没想到这破系统居然抽象到这种程度。

    被打的这明明是自己，不过这系统竟然说自己残伤同门禽兽不如。

    这系统抽什么风啊？陈默在心中吐槽道。

    “好你个陈默竟然还敢还手，你刚刚到底用了什么卑鄙的手段？”

    “竟然把师兄的拳劲挡了回来。”

    “害得林师兄差点没站稳因此而受伤。”

    “在陆云师兄的面前你竟然敢如此放肆！我看你是不想活了吧？”

    刚刚那个姓林的师兄听到这话以后脸色难看。

    因为他明显的感觉到。

    刚刚出拳的一瞬间打在陈默的身上，那被弹射回来的力道差点让他吐血重伤。

    而且他清楚地感觉到那是一股很强的压迫感。

    也就是说极有可能是陈默的实力超过了他，所以才会如此。

    可问题是……这不可能啊。

    陈默的实力如今不过是区区的炼气期。

    而且被林凤瑶师姐当做炉鼎反复吸收他的真元，他的实力只会更弱不可能比他强。

    因此表情也震惊了起来但他怎么说也是八层的筑基期高手。

    要是连一个陈默都收拾不了。

    以后在整个青云宗外门还有何他的立足之处？

    尤其是旁边的陆云这时候也皱着眉头。

    “姓林的，你作为我的跟班不会连陈默这个废物都收拾不了吧？”

    “我告诉你你要是连他这区区的炼气期都对付不了。”

    “以后你就别跟着我了，我丢不起这个人。”

    陆云冷笑道。

    “陆云师兄……”

    那姓林的师兄见状此时有些骑虎难下。

    心想刚刚一定是巧合，或者是自己分心了所以才会如此。

    自己只要用尽全力怎么可能连一个区区练气期的陈默都对付不了？

    对方立刻出手，“陈默你给我死吧！”

    见到对方攻了过来，陈默下意识地驱动一道口诀几乎是出于本能的反应。

    接着便看到雷光闪现在他身上，然后朝着那林师兄攻去。

    对方的表情大变，见到那道雷光他表情惊恐。

    非常清楚那意味着什么。

    至少也是上品的法术，要不然绝不可能有这么强的威力。

    他正准备要闪躲结果发现已经来不及了。

    轰的一声那雷光直接劈在了他身上。

    然后就听到他的惨叫声。

    整个人的身体已经被烧焦了一片，不光衣服就连皮肤也留下了不少的灼伤。

    对方的表情也变得狰狞了起来。
content_en:
Chen Mo really didn't expect that this broken system could be abstracted to this level.

    It was obviously him who was beaten, but the system actually said that he was injured and inferior to other beasts.

    What's wrong with this system? Chen Mo complained in his heart.

    "How dare you, Chen Mo, fight back? What despicable means did you just use?"

    "He actually blocked senior brother's punch."

    "Senior Brother Lin almost lost his balance and was injured because of it."

    "How dare you be so presumptuous in front of Senior Brother Lu Yun! I think you don't want to live anymore, right?"

    The senior brother named Lin just now looked ugly when he heard this.

    Because he clearly felt it.

    The moment he punched Chen Mo, the force of the ejection almost caused him to vomit blood and seriously injure him.

    And he clearly felt that it was a strong sense of oppression.

    In other words, it is very likely that Chen Mo's strength exceeds his, so that's why.

    But the problem is...this is impossible.

    Chen Mo's strength is now only in the Qi refining stage.

    Moreover, being used as a cauldron by Senior Sister Lin Fengyao to repeatedly absorb his true energy, his strength will only become weaker and impossible to be stronger than him.

    Therefore, his expression was also shocked, but he was still an eighth-level foundation-building master.

    If even Chen Mo can't deal with it.

    Where will he have a foothold in the outer sect of Qingyun Sect in the future?

    Especially Lu Yun next to him was also frowning at this time.

    "Lin, as my follower, you won't be able to take care of Chen Mo, right?"

    "I'm telling you, you can't even deal with his Qi refining period."

    "Don't follow me anymore. I can't afford to embarrass this person."

    Lu Yun sneered.

    "Senior Brother Lu Yun..."

    Seeing this, the senior brother surnamed Lin was a little bit too hard to get off.

    I thought it must have been a coincidence, or maybe I was distracted.

    How could he not be able to deal with Chen Mo, who was only in his Qi training period, as long as he tried his best?

    The other party immediately took action, "Chen Mo, just die!"

    Seeing the opponent attacking, Chen Mo subconsciously activated a mantra almost out of instinct.

    Then he saw lightning flashing on him, and then he attacked Senior Brother Lin.

    The other party's expression changed drastically, and he looked horrified when he saw the lightning.

    Be very clear about what that means.

    At least it is a top-grade spell, otherwise it would never be so powerful.

    He was about to dodge but found it was too late.

    With a bang, the lightning struck him directly.

    Then his screams were heard.

    His entire body had been scorched, and not only his clothes but also his skin had a lot of burns.

    The other party's expression also became ferocious.
title_en: Chapter 2 The spirit stone was robbed!
